verdict.rationale: Building custom AI agents is a fair capability to ask of a work-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack only shows Rovo AI being used to create custom automations, assign tasks and surface trends, which is an adjacent feature and not a documented custom-agent builder. Forge developer sites and the MCP server are developer building blocks or a different story, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date
